summary: Full backend + frontend testing for ABHYUDAYA-CHATURBHUJ MVP. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases passed across auth, role guards, issues CRUD, filters, analyze, upvote toggle, suggestions, donations, gov stats/insights/recurring (2 clusters verified: 5+ potholes Bengaluru, 4+ garbage Mumbai), status updates, and image upload/serve. Frontend (mobile 390x844): login (citizen+gov), demo button, role toggle, home nearby issues, issue detail (hero image, Leaflet map, System Analysis, upvote 6->7, donate modal presets confirm with 'Thank you' message), Explore (scope+category filters), Report form (all chips + image + location + submit testIDs), Profile logout, Government Dashboard (17 issues + priority list), Insights (2 recurring cluster cards + bar charts), Gov Map (filters + 17 markers), and status chip update reflected in dashboard metrics. Every critical user flow works end-to-end and integrates correctly with the backend.

minor.issue: Pytest warning: helper method returns a tuple instead of None (used as reusable helper). Cosmetic; does not affect correctness.

issues: React Native web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted repeatedly. Non-blocking but should be fixed by moving pointerEvents from prop to style in touchable/view components.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native for web deprecation: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Emitted by libraries or app components; consider moving to style. Reference: browser console during any screen load.

action_items: (Low) Fix the pytest helper `TestSuggestions.test_add_and_list_suggestion` to not return a tuple (extract into a plain helper) to silence the warning.
(Low) Address the React Native web `pointerEvents` deprecation by moving it into the `style` object where used, or upgrade the offending dependency if it originates from a library.

(Info) Citizen tab labelled 'My Issues' is reachable via bottom nav but not at path `/my` (I used a guessed URL). If the intended deep-link path differs from what users type, consider aliasing to a friendlier route.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates concerns and correctly excludes MongoDB `_id` in all list/detail responses (`{_id: 0}` projections).

Auth is solid: bcrypt hashing, JWT with expiry, role check on `/api/auth/login` returns 403 on role mismatch, `require_role('government')` guards `/api/stats`, `/api/insights`, PATCH status, and mark-useful.
Rule-based ai_service and priority scoring are deterministic, transparent, and well-documented.
Upvote endpoint uses unique index `(issue_id, user_id)` and correctly toggles both count and `has_upvoted` state.
Recurring detection deterministically returns >=2 seeded clusters (pothole Bengaluru, garbage Mumbai). Verified via API and Insights UI.
Frontend testIDs are present on all critical interactive elements. Text is wrapped in Text components; Leaflet map integration is via web view and renders correctly.
Consider adding server-side validation for donation currency/precision beyond the current Pydantic gt=0 / le=1000000 (already reasonable for prototype).
seed_data_creation: Tests created a citizen account with TEST_ prefix email, a TEST_pothole issue, TEST_ suggestion, and small donations on the first seeded issue. Data lives in Mongo; harmless for further testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All routes are prefixed /api and mounted directly on the FastAPI app. Login is JSON {email,password,role?} (not OAuth form). Government-only endpoints: GET /api/stats, /api/insights, PATCH /api/issues/{id}/status, POST /api/suggestions/{id}/useful. Frontend testIDs to remember: role-citizen, role-government, login-email, login-password, login-submit, use-demo, home-issue-<n>, priority-issue-<n>, issue-back, leaflet-map, upvote-button, open-donate, donate-preset-{50|100|250|500}, donate-custom, confirm-donate, open-suggestion, status-{Reported|Verified|In Progress|Resolved}, logout-button, report-title/description/cat-<name>/sev-<name>/upload-image/capture-image/use-current-location/select-on-map/submit-issue.
rca_of_issue: No production RCA needed — all critical flows pass. The single flaky area to be aware of is React Native web console noise from `pointerEvents` prop; this does not affect functionality.
